==============================================================================\n400\t\n401\t/**\n402\t * Check if a receiver state can be resumed (D22).\n403\t *\n404\t * Resume is NOT supported when     docs/notes/bf-2vke-compression-resume-t4-reap-interaction.md\n416\t */\n417\texport function canResumeRecv(state: RecvSessionState): boolean {\n418\t  if (state.type !== 'paused' && state.type !== bitIndex);\n475\t}\n476\t\n477\t// ==============================================================================\n478\t// BLOCK POSITION TRACKING FOR WRITES\n479\t//  this._currentPosition = getCurrentWritePosition(state);\n500\t  }\n501\t\n502\t  /**\n503\t   * Current write position as block index.\n504\t   * Tracks the next expected block to be written.\n505\t   */\n506\t  get currentPosition(): number {\n507\t    return this._currentPosition;\n508\t  }\n509\t\n510\t  /**\n511\t   * Total number of blocks written so far.\n512\t   */\n513\t  get
